State and calendar lead; the offers stay\\r\\n// reachable but demoted (2026-08-13 decision: demote, do not hide).\\r\\n\\r\\nconst invoke = async (action: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {\\r\\n  // Wait for the session so we never send the anon key as the Bearer [REDACTED] —\\r\\n  // the function reads that as a token with no user and answers 401.\\r\\n  const { waitForAccessToken } = await import(\\"@/lib/waitForSession\\");\\r\\n  const token = await waitForAccessToken();\\r\\n  if (!token) throw new Error(\\"Please sign in again to load your booking.\\");\\r\\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(\\"student-booking\\", { body: { action, ...extra } });\\r\\n  // supabase-js discards the response body on a non-2xx, leaving only the\\r\\n  // generic wrapper string. Read the real `{ error }` back off the Response so\\r\\n  // the code (slot_conflict, no_active_pass, ...) survives to the UI, which\\r\\n  // maps it to something the student can act on.\\r\\n  if (error) throw new Error(await edgeErrorText(error));\\r\\n  if ((data as { error?: string })?.error) throw new Error((data as { error: string }).error);\\r\\n  return data;\\r\\n};\\r\\n\\r\\nexport default function BookingView() {\\r\\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\\r\\n  const [commerce, setCommerce] = useState<{ offers: BookingOffer[]; commerce: BookingCommerceItem[]; external_bookings: ExternalBookingItem[]; bookings: { source: \\"redemption\\" | \\"single_session\\"; id: string; start_at: string; status: string }[] } | null>(null);\\r\\n  const [hasCredits, setHasCredits] = useState(false);\\r\\n\\r\\n  const api: BookingApi = useMemo(() => ({\\r\\n    loadInfo: async () => {\\r\\n      const d = (await invoke(\\"info\\")) as {\\r\\n        pass: { credits_remaining: number; session_length_minutes: number; total_credits: number; status: string } | null;\\r\\n        bookings?: { source: \\"redemption\\" | \\"single_session\\"; id: string; start_at: string; status: string; meet_url?: string | null }[];\\r\\n        offers?: BookingOffer[];\\r\\n        commerce?: BookingCommerceItem[];\\r\\n        external_bookings?: ExternalBookingItem[];\\r\\n      };\\r\\n      setCommerce({ offers: d.offers ?? [], commerce: d.commerce ?? [], external_bookings: d.external_bookings ?? [], bookings: d.bookings ?? [] });\\r\\n      const p = d.pass;\\r\\n      setHasCredits((p?.credits_remaining ?? 0) > 0);\\r\\n      return {\\r\\n        pass: p ? { credits_remaining: p.credits_remaining, session_length_minutes: p.session_length_minutes, total_credits: p.total_credits, status: p.status } : null,\\r\\n        bookings: d.bookings ?? [],\\r\\n      };\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    loadSlots: async () => {\\r\\n      const d = (await invoke(\\"slots\\")) as {\\r\\n        pass: { credits_remaining: number; session_length_minutes: number } | null;\\r\\n        slots: { start_at: string; end_at: string }[];\\r\\n      };\\r\\n      return { pass: d.pass ?? null, slots: d.slots ?? [] };\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    book: async (startAtIso, idempotencyKey, studentNote) => {\\r\\n      await invoke(\\"book\\", {\\r\\n        start_at: startAtIso,\\r\\n        idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,\\r\\n        ...(studentNote ? { student_note: studentNote } : {}),\\r\\n      });\\r\\n      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\\"student-booking\\", \\"info\\"] });\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    uploadFiles: async (files, idempotencyKey) => {\\r\\n      const fd = new FormData();\\r\\n      fd.append(\\"idempotency_key\\", idempotencyKey);\\r\\n      for (const entry of files) {\\r\\n        fd.append(\\"files\\", entry.file, entry.file.name);\\r\\n        fd.append(\\"client_upload_ids\\", entry.clientUploadId);\\r\\n"}}'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '{"i":2,"status":"fulfilled","value":{"chunk_id":"7c000d","wall_time_seconds":7.0741674,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":629,"output":"# Booking — Context\\r\\n\\r\\nThe language of paying for and scheduling tutoring time. Covers the student booking surface (`/schedule`, `/booking`), the public booking microsite (`/book/:slug`), and the Single Session page.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terms\\r\\n\\r\\n### Single Session\\r\\nOne tutoring session paid for individually ($45 for the 70-minute session) rather than out of a Package, booked from a public shareable link by anyone — prospect or current student — without logging in. Needs no Booking Pass. Replaces the Cal.com \\"LSAT Session\\" (`session-link`) event, which stays live in parallel until Joshua retires it. _Avoid (per the root glossary): one-off, ad hoc session, hourly._\\r\\n\\r\\n### Package\\r\\nFive or ten hours of tutoring bought upfront through Stripe, consumed by booking sessions out of a Booking Pass.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Booking Pass\\r\\nThe prepaid entitlement a student holds when sessions are **owed** to them, carrying the count owed and the count used, reachable at its own private high-entropy booking link. Granted by Joshua or by a matched package payment. A Single Session never creates or consumes one. _Avoid: booking link (that is the pass\'s URL, not the thing), wallet, credits-as-product._\\r\\n\\r\\n### Booker\\r\\nThe person on the public page picking a slot. Not necessarily an authenticated user or an existing student; identified by the name and email they enter.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Slot\\r\\nA concrete start time offered on the calendar. For the Single Session, slots run at a 70-minute pitch from the start of each day\'s availability window, within the booking window, respecting minimum notice and calendar conflicts.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Hold\\r\\nA short-lived claim on a Slot created when a Booker submits their details and is sent to payment.
